model: single thermal node per Ta-absorber/TES pixel with nonlinear voltage-biased electrothermal feedback

electrical.bias_rule: derive I0 and Thevenin voltage from thermal equilibrium at each G

parameter_provenance.Ta_density: NIST ESTAR material composition for tantalum: https://physics.nist.gov/cgi-bin/Star/compos.pl?matno=073
parameter_provenance.G_Rn_R0_Tbath_n: explicit modeling assumptions; Tbath=50 mK is also the current mixing-chamber stage

resistance_models.normal_fraction: R/Rn=x/(1+x), x=(T/Tc)^m, m chosen to match alpha at R0

signal.candidate_C: five-replicate mean of actual tuned-C G4CMP sensor-hit energy and arrival time plus direct TES deposits
signal.candidate_A_B: energy-matched counterfactual: high-collection G4CMP channel/time pattern rescaled to the eta required for exactly 511 keV

scope_limits: Ta absorber and TES film are one isothermal lumped node
each TES pixel is an independent node connected only to its own bath
no SQUID/readout transfer function or noise PSD
constant Ta heat capacity from the current manuscript is used over the pulse excursion
